blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – A residential fire broke out Tuesday afternoon, October 6, 2026, in Sitio Catleya, Garfield St., Barangay Pahina San Nicolas, Cebu City, causing an estimated P300,000 in property damage. According to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Cebu City Fire Station, the incident was reported at 5:14 p.m. Fire trucks were dispatched at 5:15 p.m. and arrived at the scene two minutes later at 5:17 p.m., covering a distance of approximately one kilometer.
